[Page 1]
Contoso Field Notes pilot proposal
Purpose: test the Field Notes app with two service teams before a wider rollout.

[Page 2]
Scope: the pilot covers the Leeds and Bristol service teams, 40 engineers in total.
Success measure: engineers file visit notes within 2 hours of a visit in 80% of cases.

[Page 3]
Costs: licences cost GBP 12 per user per month. Training needs one half-day session per team.
Risk: offline sync has not been tested on older Android devices.

[Page 4]
Timeline: pilot starts 11 January 2027 and runs for eight weeks. A go or no-go review follows in March 2027.
